title: Personalization Aids Pluralistic Alignment Under Competition
reasoning: The paper studies pluralistic alignment of AI models across diverse users, specifically incorporating 'Religion' as one of the primary demographic partitions for its empirical analysis. It measures how well LLMs (as providers) can satisfy the preferences and values of different religious groups (such as Protestant, Mormon, and Jewish users) and explores the ethical challenges of aligning a model with diverse societal values.
